execute_graph: execute a GraphModule using the aten executor with positional tensor arguments
make_traced_function: wrap a callable with make_traced to trace torch operations to prims and execute them
run_traced_torch_ops: run a traced torch function that executes prims on the requested trace executor
build_traced_torch_module: build a traced torch module that traces operations to prims and executes via aten
test_make_traced: test make_traced by wrapping a torch function and verifying traced execution
